newsitem.title: CANADA: Rumor mill pushes Bre-X, Barrick.
newsitem.headline: Rumor mill pushes Bre-X, Barrick.

text.p: The rumor mill surrounding Bre-X Minerals Ltd shifted into high gear again on Wednesday as investors speculated about the outcome of Bre-X's negotiations with its Indonesian partners and Barrick Gold Corp, analysts said.
Bre-X stock was up 0.40 to 22.65 on more than 820,000 shares in early trading in Toronto on Wednesday. The stock rose 1.05 on Tuesday to 22.25.
Barrick was also active today, rising 0.20 to 35.40 on 714,000 shares in Toronto. Barrick and Bre-X have a tentative deal to operate the Busang gold find in Indonesia.
Barrick was unchanged at 26 in New York on 972,000 shares.
Placer Dome Inc, which also wants to work with Bre-X on Busang, was active too in Toronto, unchanged at 27.15 on 850,000 shares. Placer was up 1/8 in New York to 20-1/8.

Bre-X and Barrick have been in talks with their respective local partners over the Busang property, in an effort to reach an agreement before a fast approaching government-imposed deadline. The government sent both companies a letter in the middle of January, giving them a month to settle with their partners, but the exact date of the deadline was unclear.
While some analysts expected an agreement -- or at least an update on negotiations -- by Friday, others said they did not expect anything until Monday at the earliest.

"All I can say is we remain confident that this will be done by what we understand now to be a deadline of February 17," a Bre-X spokesman said today in an interview. "We're confident that we'll have everything resolved prior to that."

A source close to the negotiations told Reuters in Jakarta that a deal between Bre-X and Barrick was expected by the end of this week. "I expect things to be in place by the end of this week," the source said. "We are expected to settle the negotiations by this week."

The speculation about the deadline and the outcome of the negotiations fueled trading in all three companies, analysts said. At stake is the 57 million ounce Busang gold find in Kalimantan province. The Bre-X spokesman said the company planned to release a new resource calculation "soon."

The Indonesian government has asked Bre-X and Barrick to form a joint venture to develop the deposit and work out agreements with their local partners, while giving a 10 percent stake to the Indonesian government.
